Fix a conical Hamiltonian symplectic resolution $X$ with its $T\times\mathbb{G}_{m}$ -action with isolated $T$ -fixed points. Fix a $T$ -equivariant cohomology class $x\in H^{*}_{T}(X;k)$. Then the corresponding $T\times\mathbb{G}_{m}$ -equivariant quantum Steenrod operator

(3.10)

$\Sigma_{x}^{T}:H^{*}_{T\times\mathbb{G}_{m},loc}(X;\hat{\Lambda})[\![{t,\theta}]\!]\to H^{*}_{T\times\mathbb{G}_{m},loc}(X;\hat{\Lambda})[\![{t,\theta}]\!],$

where $H^{*}_{T\times\mathbb{G}_{m},loc}(X;\hat{\Lambda})[\![{t,\theta}]\!]:=H^{*}_{T\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(X;\hat{\Lambda})[\![{t,\theta}]\!]\otimes\mathrm{Frac}(H^{*}_{T\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(\mathrm{pt}))$ is the localized equivariant cohomology, is well-defined.

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
